title: Backend Engineer-JAVA
description: We are looking for a Backend Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in Java and Spring Boot development to build and maintain secure, scalable, and cloud-based applications. The ideal candidate should have experience with microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, application security, and Azure cloud technologies.
requirements:
Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in Backend Development.
  • Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices Architecture.
  • Good understanding of Spring Core, Dependency Injection (DI), IoC, AOP, and Spring Data.
  • Experience with Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, and secure authentication mechanisms.
  • Strong knowledge of Spring MVC and RESTful API development.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Logic Apps.
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on Azure Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, API Management, SQL, and Cosmos DB.
  • Understanding of OWASP security standards and secure coding practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certifications.
  • Experience with cloud-native applications and containerized environments.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Knowledge of application performance optimization and monitoring.
